name: UniBench-NLP
description: Source code, datasets and full results accompanying the paper "UniBench-NLP". The archive contains the benchmark framework (Python), the evaluation datasets (consistency-probe pairs, BBQ bias items, summarization and Wikipedia summarization samples), all raw model outputs, AI-judge verdicts, the five independent human rating files, and the scripts that recompute every number in the paper (scripts/paper_stats.py). See README.md for setup and usage.
